messages:
Alex G: hey team, first-day question — where do our canonical docs live in Notion? trying to find onboarding checklist and PRD templates :thinking_face:
Elaine (she/her): welcome Alex :wave: main hub is the "Redwood Docs Index" page under the OSS workspace. quick link: https://redwood.notion.site/Redwood-Docs-Index (if link prompts access, hit request)
Alex G: thanks! I clicked and it says I need permission to view — is that normal?
DevEx Bot: System: If you see an access prompt, use the 'Request access' button and select your manager or the 'devex' group for expedited approval.
Samir: permissions are a mix — most product + infra docs are public to the company, some sensitive runbooks are page-restricted. if Request access doesn't work, ping #devex or DM Elaine.
Alex G: cool. where are the templates (PRD, runbook, engineering design doc)?
Elaine (she/her): templates live under "Doc Templates" inside the Docs Index. look for: - Onboarding checklist - PRD (Shiproom) template - Runbook template - Engineering Design Spec template
Devon: quick how-to: duplicate the template page then edit the copy. in Notion click the ••• menu (top-right) -> Duplicate.
Alex G: can I share my copy with the team for review? what's the recommended process?
Lina: yes — share the page with the relevant Slack channel, add reviewers with comment access first. we usually do a short review sync or use the PRD review checklist. for design specs, tag @engineering and @product.
Samir: if you need edit access for an org-level doc (not just your copy), ask a doc owner — owners are listed at the top right under 'Share' -> 'Owners'.
Alex G: I still can't see the Runbook template after duplicating — it shows as "Restricted" when I open copy
Elaine (she/her): that means the parent page has page-level restrictions. try duplicating from the templates root. if blocked, send me the page URL and I'll add you.
Alex G: thanks Elaine — sending URL now.
DevEx Bot: Tip: for runbooks that touch infra, include the runbook label: `ops-runbook` in the top tags and ping @oncall in the doc footer.
Alex G: one more: is there a shared onboarding checklist I should follow for the first week?
Elaine (she/her): yes — "New Hire 1wk Checklist" in the Docs Index. it covers account setup, security training, Slack channels to join, git access, and who-to-ask list. copy it to your workspace and mark items done.
Alex G: perfect. any shortcuts for requesting edit access en masse?
Samir: not really — Notion permissions are per-page. but if you need a bunch, we can bulk-grant by adding you to the `@redwood-docs-editors` group (requires a ticket). ping #devex with a list.
Alex G: ok will do. thx all! :raised_hands:
Elaine (she/her): welcome aboard! if you hit any more Notion weirdness DM me or post here. cc @Lina for runbook tips.
Lina: happy to help with runbook structure or review — welcome Alex!
Alex G: appreciate it, folks. starting the checklist now.
Devon: also, older templates have a legacy prefix. if something looks odd, search for the most-recent template by last modified date.
Alex G: noted. closing out — will follow up in #devex if stuck.
